verdicts.reason: A: the text column is indented about 108px from the left edge, but the SOLSTICE logo sits at about 50px and is left on its own in the bottom-left corner, so they don't share an edge. The bottle is also small and pushed high inside the circle. B: the quote mark, quote and attribution share a clean left edge and the bottle sits better in the circle, but the attribution has been enlarged enough to compete with the quote, the logo is jammed right under it with no breathing room, and the circle is clipped at both the top and the bottom.
